Select exact IC50 activities against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) for compounds that have a structure and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type IC50, and presence of canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi). Return all requested columns without deduplication. Sort by all output columns.
